note: Small, secluded campground in the wooded valley of the North Branch Whitewater River near Plainview; rough terrain makes it hard going for large RVs, and the DNR names sites 1 and 16 as the best for them. No office on site (run from Whitewater State Park). --Claude
summary: DNR record spk00130 + ReserveMN facility 874 read: $20 confirmed; 20 sites, DNR limit 30 ft (spurs 30-75), one pull-through (16); open Memorial Day-Labor Day weekends (2027 opens May 28); vault toilets, seasonal water, no showers/flush. Not waterfront kept. Phone 507-312-2300; dead DNR link replaced.
